name: Barbell Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Lie flat on a bench with your feet planted firmly and hold a barbell over your shoulders with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Keep your upper arms vertical or angled slightly back and lock your shoulder blades against the bench.
Bend your elbows slowly to lower the bar toward your forehead or just above your hairline.
Contract your triceps to extend your elbows back to the starting position without shifting your upper arms.
tips: Keep both elbows pointing upward and control the descent carefully near your head.
Keep your wrists straight in line with your forearms throughout each repetition.
